annotation.bound_parties_text: The opinion directs local governments (provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities), State Council departments such as civil affairs, finance and health insurance authorities, the China Disabled Persons' Federation, and disabled-person care service institutions.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: 各地要加强组织领导，将重度残疾人托养照护服务作为重要民生工程，加大投入支持力度，统筹做好相关工作
